newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Feb 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Feb 18.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- Public health care to reach level of similar systems in developed countries by 2010, Communist Party central committee says
- Beijing introduces $2.26 billion of foreign investment in 1996, up 14.7 percent over previous year and record for China's capital
- Chinese Premier Li Peng solicits opinions from non-Communist Party senior officials about draft report on government work to be delivered at upcoming annual session of National People's Congress.
- Troops and local residents of various ethnic groups in Xinjiang help each other
- By end-1996, 147 foreign-funded financial institutions had set up representative offices in Shanghai, with total assets of $13.547 billion
- China forecasts first quarter GDP up 10 percent
- Railway authorities predicting new railroad construction boom, using 34.4 billion yuan this year.
- A master plan for econmic growth for city of Beijing is outlined. High-tech industries are to focus.
